text:
About 2.23% of the property (ASSET-A, 3,643.5 ha) was affected by tree-cover loss in 2021. That equals roughly 81.3 ha, mapped by Hansen/UMD. The result is corroborated: later years were observed, and the JRC 2020 forest reference agrees over 98% of the loss area.

Context: about 68.1 ha of the loss lies in mapped planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda). Another 13.2 ha is outside mapped forest, and none is native forest. A further 37.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha is not counted as an event.

Limits: this shows tree-cover loss only. It does not establish deforestation or land-use change, since cutting a plantation also counts as loss. It also says nothing about cause, legality, responsible actor, or regulatory compliance.
